desc: Developed and maintained various web-based projects, including e-commerce landing pages, blogs, gaming websites, and interactive forms. Worked on implementing responsive layouts, user-facing features, and integrations based on the requirements of each project.

General Release focuses on 3 iOS-based applications; PULL, PUSH, and SL. These applications handle operators account management, customers management, orders, sales, and other business operations. Armstrong API manages the data for all GR apps and the server.
It is a web based application handling operators, account and customers management, orders, sales, and other business operations.

These are venture projects initiated by the company

Housify is a web-based application offering Content Management Systems and a Corporate site. It follows the rules of subscription-based business models and offers listing and management services for the client.

Petpal is modeled as Software as a Service (SaaS). It has a mobile application for Pet Owners and a web application for Veterinarians. The services it offers ranges from quick chats, teleconsultations, home visit appointments, clinic visits and more.

KonsultaMD is a healthcare SaaS platform that provides patients with convenient access to licensed and specialized healthcare professionals, institutions, and digital healthcare services, including online consultations and medical advice.
MI Global is a web-based travel and itinerary planning platform for organizing trips, accommodations, activities, events, and budgets, helping users estimate travel costs.
JTI is a workforce management and payroll platform managing employee assignments, work hours, overtime, leave, holidays, shifts, schedules, allowances, pay slips, and payroll information.
La Boucherie Store is an e-commerce platform for meat products with custom preparation options, checkout, order management, reporting, and an admin portal.

Everlasting is a SaaS event management platform for creating events, inviting guests, tracking attendance, photo services, albums, comments, and reviews. An admin portal supports user and content management.

POMA is a government platform for Protection of Minors Register certificate applications, payments, processing, and certificate management. A back-office portal supports users, entities, requests, and reports.

MMC is a government case management platform supporting mediation cases, parties, mediators, scheduling, payments, and document management. A back-office portal supports user and cases management, mediators, documents, and reports.
